glosses: To develop or give form to (something) according to a plan or process.

examples.text: The dirty secret of the internet is that all this distraction and interruption is immensely profitable. Web companies like to boast about […], or offering services that let you [...] "share the things you love with the world" and so on. But the real way to build a successful online business is to be better than your rivals at undermining people's control of their own attention.

examples.text: Since the launch early last year of […] two Silicon Valley start-ups offering free education through MOOCs, massive open online courses, the ivory towers of academia have been shaken to their foundations. glosses: A structure, such as a building, statue, pool or forest created by the player.

examples.text: I made a build centered around attack speed.
